statements.status_notes: Jetty 9.4.57 is embedded in the Hadoop hadoop-client-runtime shaded JAR while Apache Hadoop 3.4.x still pins that line; a fix needs Jetty 9.4.60+ in a future Hadoop release. Jetty 11.0.x for Spark is blocked from upgrading to the advisory fixed version (11.0.28) because org.eclipse.jetty artifacts for 11.0.28 are not yet published on the Maven Central repositories used by the build.

For Jetty 9.4.57 embedded in the Hadoop hadoop-client-runtime JAR, the scanner reports no fixed version on the 9.4.x line; waiting for a Hadoop client release that repins Jetty. For Jetty 11.0.24 and 11.0.26 used by Spark, advisories list no released fix; waiting for a Jetty 11.0.x release that addresses this issue on Maven Central.
